notes: INSIDE half of the Mire Bog Mortar: a glass slurry tank of green bog water with rising bubbles, a feed pipe, repair hatch, power coupling and the five water-gauge tubes (frame 5 = ready). fire: the tubes flash and the slurry sloshes. damaged: the tank leaks green drips, tubes dead; disabled: the tank is cracked and empty, slurry spilled. Barrel layer mire_bog_mortar_barrel: a short wide mortar tube with brass bands and a flared brass mouth rimmed with green slime that drips; fire: a green lob of slime. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
